newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ausdoc directors reject Brambles bid.
newsitem.headline: Ausdoc directors reject Brambles bid.

text.p: Document exchange firm Ausdoc Group Ltd said on Monday that its directors unanimously recommended that shareholders rejected the A$2 per share takeover bid by transport group Brambles Industries Ltd.
The directors said their recommendation was partly based on a finding by independent expert Grant Samuel and Associates that Ausdoc shares were worth between A$2.32 and A$2.61 per share.
They also said directors and senior management who control about 25 percent of the issued capital had indicated they would not accept the Brambles bid.
"Brambles has not offered an adequate premium for the strategic value and substantial operational synergies it will obtain if it gains control of Ausdoc," the target company said.
Ausdoc shares ended unchanged at A$2.20 on Monday, giving the company a market capitalisation of A$125.49 million based on 57.04 million shares outstanding.
Its shares were valued at A$1.63 each the day before Brambles unveiled its bid on December 23.
